hints.title: Independent Character Alignment
hints.text: Calculate the forward cyclic shift required to transform each character into target.

hints.title: Modulo Shift Distance
hints.text: Compute (ord(target[i]) - ord(s[i])) modulo 26 for each index.

hints.title: Total Operations Sum
hints.text: Sum the cyclic distances across all characters in the string.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: length of strings s and target
complexity.notes: Single pass character distance summation modulo 26.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Incrementing characters iteratively in a simulation loop is slow.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use modular arithmetic to compute cyclic shift distance.
